origin.description: Primary Key, tracking the FTA code and HS code (format: ftaCode#hsCode)

effectiveFrom.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the tariff becomes effective

taxRate.description: Ad valorem tax rate expressed as a fraction (e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

surcharges.description: List of additional surcharges applied to the tariff

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the surcharge (e.g., USD, EUR)

baseCurrency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for the base tariff calculation

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last update to this tariff record

notes.description: Optional free-text field for remarks about this tariff entry
